set.body: Initialize and publish the canonical canardlapin/ravel repository. Acceptance: coherent initial commit; full JDK 21, Node 22, and Chromium GitHub Actions gate; signed ravel-core and ravel-laws JVM/Scala.js 1.0.0 artifacts on Maven Central; v1.0.0 tag; Gale interop updated to the released version and verified; post-release Scalafmt, MiMa, diagnostic coverage, and Scala Next consumer gates tracked and landed.
set.title: Publish Ravel 1.0.0
